footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Freeport-McMoRan: includes $1.0M from equity in affiliated companies’ net earn; after $1.9B attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 1.8% to $25.9B in 2025. Operating income fell 5.0% to $6.5B, a 25.2% margin.
Net income rose 16.7% to $2.2B, or $1.52 per share. Operating cash flow was $5.6B and free cash flow $1.1B, versus $2.4B; Freeport-McMoRan returned $972M through dividends and buybacks.
